fee_notes: Standard initial franchise fee is $45,000 per new Meineke Center. Reduced to $22,500 for a second franchised Center and $20,000 for third and subsequent Centers under a Development Agreement. A 25% discount applies for existing Driven Brands Holdings affiliate franchisees on single unit development. Conversion program fee is $20,000 for qualifying independent or franchised repair facilities. Incentive programs may waive all or a portion of the fee. During fiscal year ended December 28, 2024, franchisees paid between $0 and $45,000. Additional initial fees include: $4,995 M.Key software license fee ($0–$4,995 paid in FY2024), $200–$1,200 AutoNet TV Fee, and $20,000 Initial Advertising Contribution. Development Fee equals 100% of the applicable initial franchise fee per Center (one developer paid $107,500 in total Development Fees in FY2024). Discounts and incentives may not be combined.
raw_excerpt: We charge an initial franchise fee of $45,000 for each new Meineke Center franchise. You must pay the entire initial franchise fee of $45,000 when you sign the Franchise Agreement. The initial franchise fee is not refundable under any circumstances. ... During the fiscal year ended December 28, 2024, franchisees signing a franchise agreement paid or committed to pay an initial franchise fee between $0 and $45,000.
